UPDATE comms_queue
               SET
                   status = CASE
                       WHEN attempts + 1 >= max_attempts THEN 'failed'
                       ELSE 'pending'
                   END,
                   attempts = attempts + 1,
                   last_error = $2,
                   updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
                   scheduled_for = datetime('now', printf('+%d minutes', attempts + 1))
               WHERE id = $1
